# Southline — Outreach Lists

Two separate lists. Dedupe each against your already-sent log before you start.

- **SMS list** = mobiles → text these (AI receptionist for tradesmen).
- **Cold-call list** = business landlines → phone/email these (digital marketing pitch).

---

# 1) BULK SMS — 100 FRESH TRADES (mobiles)

Electricians, carpenters, plasterers/tilers, roofers, painters, landscapers.
All different from the plumber list. Textable.

## The message to send (use this one)

> Hey, Ryan here — quick one. Do you ever miss calls when you're up a ladder or on the tools? I set up an AI receptionist for tradesmen that answers every call, gets the job details and texts them straight to you. Worth a chat?

(Put a line break before "Worth a chat?" so it lands on its own.)
